page.overview:
Who is Trunkovs?

Trunkovs are a criminal family of lemon thugs who work for Vladimir Trunkov. The bodyguard Trunkovs are first seen playing in the casino, while two other Trunkovs end up getting defeated in London by Finn McMissile and Holley Shiftwell.

Vladimir is then arrested by Sheriff, while the others get arrested by Scotland Yard. A remaining bodyguard Trunkov tries to flee the fight with other Lemons, only to get arrested by Sarge and the British military.
